reader.notes: Every literal inside SPECIAL-NAMES is read through LiteralEnvironment.SpecialNames (inSpecialNames, so the native pins) or the ALPHABET clause's AlphabetFigurative map; both answer NativeCollatingSequence's U+FFFF / U+0000. Refusal and file/size classes do not reach this general rule.

refuter.evidence: r5sn-002: plural spellings and THRU with figuratives inside SPECIAL-NAMES: ALPHABET AL IS LOW-VALUES THRU "@" "Q" HIGH-VALUES (as the PCS) puts native U+0000..U+0040 first and native U+FFFF at position 67, so the procedure LOW-VALUE is U+0000 (LV-00), procedure HIGH-VALUE U+FFFE (HV-FE), Q and U+FFFF collate below A; CLASS CEVERY IS HIGH-VALUE THRU LOW-VALUE (descending THRU over the whole native set) holds Z; CLASS CHI IS HIGH-VALUES holds U+FFFF and not U+FFFE although the procedure HIGH-VALUE is U+FFFE. SR5 forbids only symbolic-character figuratives in these literals, so HIGH-VALUE/LOW-VALUE there are legal. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.4.5.4 GR7  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR7'; 'OK  §1985:VI.4.5.3 SR5  (4.5.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5'.
